name: Perfect Home-Oven Pizza Dough (Poolish Method)
description: Vito Iacopelli's method for light, soft-and-crunchy Neapolitan-style pizza made in a home oven, using an overnight poolish pre-ferment so the final dough is ready in about 2 hours.

itemListElement.text: Combine 300 ml room temperature water, 5 g dry yeast and 5 g honey, and stir until the yeast melts.
Add 300 g of 00 flour and mix until combined.
Cover and keep 1 hour at room temperature, then refrigerate overnight (about 24 hours) until fermented and bubbly.
Put 700 ml water in a bowl and add all of the fermented poolish, mixing to dissolve it into the water.
Add most of the 1250 g flour and mix, then add 40 g sea salt, then add the remaining flour.
Mix with a spatula until it comes together, turn out onto the counter, and work by hand until smooth; it will still be sticky.
Cover and let the dough rest for 15 minutes.
With oiled hands, fold the edges in toward the top to build tension and shape into a large smooth ball.
Coat the ball with a little olive oil, cover, and leave 30 minutes at room temperature.
Divide the dough into balls, about 100 g each. Place on a semolina-dusted tray two to three fingers apart, oil the tops, cover, and rest 2 hours at room temperature.
Place a pizza stone in the oven and preheat at maximum temperature (around 300C) for 40 minutes to 1 hour.
Make the sauce: lightly blend or hand-crush a can of whole peeled tomatoes, then stir in 1 tsp salt, a little olive oil and torn fresh basil.
Drain and cut the fresh mozzarella into roughly 1/4-inch slices (do not cut it too thin).
Open a dough ball by dusting with flour and pressing the air outward to the edges, keeping a raised crust.
Flip and stretch the dough to about 8 to 10 inches, letting the air stay in the crust.
Top the base with just the tomato sauce and brush a little olive oil on the crust.
Slide the pizza onto the preheated stone and bake until the base is golden.
Take the pizza out, add the fresh mozzarella and parmesan, drizzle with more olive oil, and return to the oven until the mozzarella bubbles.
Remove the finished pizza, garnish with fresh basil, and serve soft and crunchy.
